content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To make a funnel cake without a funnel, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Sift the all-purpose flour into a large bowl (2 minutes)
Step 2. Whisk the eggs in a separate small container (1 minute)
Step 3. Measure out the vanilla extract (30 seconds)
Step 4. Beat the granulated sugar into the wet mixture (3 minutes)
Step 5. Plug in the deep fryer (30 seconds)
Step 6. Dust the finished cake with powdered sugar (45 seconds)
Step 7. Pour vegetable oil into the frying pot (1 minute)
Step 8. Test the oil temperature with a drop of batter (1 minute)
Step 9. Measure the baking powder (30 seconds)
Step 10. Combine the dry ingredients with the egg mixture (4 minutes)
Step 11. Prepare a plate with paper towels (1 minute)
Step 12. Check that the oil has reached 375 degrees (5 minutes)
Step 13. Whisk the batter until no large lumps remain (3 minutes)
Step 14. Cut a small hole in the corner of a heavy-duty freezer bag (30 seconds)
Step 15. Add whole milk to the beaten eggs (1 minute)
Step 16. Crack the eggs into a bowl (1 minute)
Step 17. Locate the measuring spoons (2 minutes)
Step 18. Pour the batter into the prepared freezer bag (2 minutes)

Step 21. Set out a wire cooling rack (1 minute)
Step 22. Measure the salt (30 seconds)
Step 23. Clear a large workspace on the counter (5 minutes)
Step 24. Look up a classic carnival recipe (10 minutes)

Step 26. Use tongs to flip the cake once golden (2 minutes)
Step 27. Carefully squeeze the batter into the hot oil in a circular motion (2 minutes)
Step 28. Monitor the cake for a golden-brown color (3 minutes)

Step 30. Take the eggs and milk out of the refrigerator (1 minute)
Step 31. Wipe down the counter (2 minutes)

Step 37. Melt the butter in the microwave (30 seconds)
Step 38. Fry the first side of the cake (3 minutes)
Step 39. Rinse the measuring cups (2 minutes)

Step 41. Secure the top of the freezer bag with a rubber band (1 minute)

Step 48. Beat the eggs and milk until frothy (2 minutes)
Step 49. Inspect the deep fryer for cleanliness (2 minutes)
Step 50. Add the melted butter to the liquid base (1 minute)
Step 51. Sift additional flour for texture (2 minutes)
Step 52. Stir the batter one last time (1 minute)
Step 53. Open a new bottle of frying oil (1 minute)
Step 54. Verify the consistency of the batter (1 minute)
Step 55. Set the timer for frying (30 seconds)
Step 56. Double-check the recipe measurements (2 minutes)
Step 57. Measure the flour accurately (2 minutes)
Step 58. Heat the oil to the secondary frying temperature (4 minutes)
Step 59. Incorporate the wet and dry ingredients thoroughly (3 minutes)
Step 60. Take the mixing bowl out of the cupboard (1 minute)
Step 61. Read the entire recipe instructions (5 minutes)
Step 62. Prepare the workspace for frying (3 minutes)
Step 63. Squeeze the bag to test the flow of batter (30 seconds)
Step 64. Set the fryer to the correct heat setting (1 minute)
Step 65. Overlap the batter strands in the oil to create a web (2 minutes)
Step 66. Wash the tongs (2 minutes)
Step 67. Prepare a small bowl for the topping (1 minute)
Step 68. Turn off the deep fryer (30 seconds)
Step 69. Add vanilla extract to the wet ingredients (30 seconds)
Step 70. Seal the freezer bag tightly (1 minute)
Step 71. Clean up any spilled flour (3 minutes)
Step 72. Put on a kitchen apron (1 minute)
Step 73. Serve the funnel cake while warm (1 minute)
Step 74. Retrieve the salt shaker (30 seconds)
Step 75. Transfer the cake to the cooling rack (1 minute)
Step 76. Dry the tongs with a towel (30 seconds)
Step 77. Pour the oil into the pan carefully (1 minute)
Step 78. Finalize the batter thickness (2 minutes)
Step 79. Clear a space for the finished plates (2 minutes)
Step 80. Dispose of the used freezer bag (30 seconds)
